initial_conditions: Open the supplied two-panel Harbor project at revision 24. Both patterns use authored Cotton material #1 at 0.18 kg/m².
actions: Select Harbor back, copy its assigned project fabric, enter Harbor lining and save.
Rename the copy Harbor twill, save, then edit density to 0.29 kg/m² and save again.
Select Harbor front, choose material #68 from the project picker and save. Undo, save, Redo and save.
Open an empty project, reopen the saved primary and inspect both assignments.
expected_outcomes: One new material #68 retains every physical and appearance field on creation. Editing the back copy leaves front and material #1 intact. Assigning the existing copy changes only the front assignment. Undo and Redo restore every saved field except revision.
